agent: Codex performance parent with three read-only audit subagents
scope: Category-switch latency reduced by reusing visible agent-card delegates while retaining the bounded, noninteractive preview contract.

environment.render_mode: offscreen/software; GUI-thread delivery, scene-graph sync and next frameSwapped, not GPU presentation

benchmark.layout: Both comparison states use runtime/workspace.json so atomic registry replacement does not wake the lapis.json directory watcher.
benchmark.baseline_state: Current main with corrected benchmark storage layout and delegate reuse disabled

diagnostic_preview_disabled.result: The category tail collapses when preview cards are absent; preview delegate/surface construction is material.

time_sample.tool: macOS sample, 1 ms interval for 10 seconds on the benchmark process
time_sample.result: Row construction and glyph/text-node work dominate; the sample includes CoreText shaping, glyph bounds and advances.

rejected_candidates.name: Process-wide mutable ASCII advance table
rejected_candidates.result: Rejected. With delegate reuse enabled it produced no material additional gain; without reuse, three runs regressed category p50 to 61.94-69.31 ms and p95 to 82.40-84.14 ms.
rejected_candidates.reason: The per-surface cache remains safer because it shares neither QFont nor QFontMetricsF across render contexts.

rejected_candidates.name: Differential Config watcher path churn
rejected_candidates.result: Deferred. A safe prototype passed the existing replacement-watch config test, but the corrected benchmark layout removed watcher contamination from the measured workload and no product-level gain was measured.
rejected_candidates.reason: Do not mix an unmeasured watcher change into this focused rendering PR.

non_claims: This is an offscreen/software scene-graph switch measurement, not native GPU presentation or physical key-to-pixel latency.
Agent-key p50 rose 5.77% in the paired runs while agent p95 improved 4.11%; the accepted tradeoff targets the much larger category-switch tail.
The preview-disabled run is attribution evidence only and changed the product feature under test.
No sustained-output, memory, native GPU, or physical-presentation claim is made.
